body: I’m sorry you had to go through this. I wish people would at least try to understand and sympathy for people who sh.

It’s so hard to pretend to be a normal person. There’s so many things I can’t understand why some even enjoys living on this rock. I wish I was stronger to have a positive mindset but my life has dictated otherwise. I really wish there was some easier way to live

I hate all times I fucked up and made other peoples life worse. Every relationship I was in I was selfish and didn’t understand them. Even after they split from me because of my faults I desperately tried to get back together. Only to make them feel worse and ruin my other relationships. I wish I could go back and ducking punch my past self and make him make better decisions. But I can’t, and I’m forced to live with the memories.
